# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book serves as a portfolio of my work in **DS 6400: Advanced Machine Learning I**, bringing together course notes, paper summaries, mathematical explanations and computational explorations in R.

My goal is not only to understand how different machine learning methods work, but also to build clear and reproducible examples that connect theory with practical problems. Throughout the course, I aim to relate these methods whenever possible to my interests in exercise physiology, wearable technology, digital health and human-performance analytics.
